title: On-the-Fly Lifting of Coarse Reaction-Coordinate Paths to Full-Dimensional Transition Path Ensembles
summary: Effective dynamics on a low-dimensional collective-variable (CV) or latent space can be simulated far more cheaply than the underlying high-dimensional stochastic system, but exploiting such coarse predictions requires lifting: turning a coarse CV trajectory into dynamically consistent full-dimensional states and path ensembles, without relying on global sampling of invariant or conditional fiber measures.
